verdict.rationale: The official quickstart doc describes self-serve signup at console.x.ai, API key creation, and a runnable first request in curl/Python/JavaScript in the same guide — directly matching the 'zero to first API call in minutes with runnable code' story, and the OpenAI-compatible REST API further eases onboarding for developers familiar with that ecosystem. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that onboarding actually takes only minutes, and evidence of runnable examples beyond the three languages mentioned (e.g. Go, Java, other SDKs).
